description: Golden vectors for the NWS altimeter-setting reduction (#3285). Consumed by shared-protocol weather::station_reference::altimeter_setting_hpa (Rust) and by the core4 collectors' JS port (tests/security), so the collector that computes pressure_sea_level_hpa and the attester that re-checks it reduce identically.
formula: altimeter_hpa = (p - 0.3) * (1 + ((1013.25^0.190284 * 0.0065 / 288) * (h / (p - 0.3)^0.190284)))^(1 / 0.190284); p = station pressure hPa, h = elevation m (NWS altimeter setting formula)

vectors.note: the reference station’s WS-5000 raw station pressure at 227.7 m (747 ft); KDLH altimeter setting that hour was 1027.8 hPa
